title: Coverage of shrinkage and selection priors on interactions
question: Do posterior intervals from shrinkage or selection priors on treatment-by-covariate interactions keep frequentist coverage for the transported effect when the whole procedure is repeated?
design: Continuous-outcome STC with eight candidate interactions, one strong or three moderate modifiers, two sample sizes; flat, empirical-Bayes ridge, hierarchical normal, spike-and-slab averaging and median-probability-model priors. 4 cells, 1000 replicates each.
